description: For plaid.com. Unofficial .NET client for Plaid open banking: transactions sync, UK/EU payments, identity checks (Identity Match, KYC), Auth, Assets and Income, with verified webhooks and a replaceable storage layer.
releaseNotes:
v1.2.4:
- FIXED: Sync.fetchChangesAsync and syncItemAsync return InvalidResponse when a /transactions/sync page has more and repeats a cursor or gives none, instead of paging without end; the stored cursor is kept

v1.2.3:
- CHANGED: one unreadable /transactions/sync entry no longer stops the item's sync; it is in SyncSummary.Unparsed and TransactionChanges.Unparsed, and the cursor moves past it. A store must keep them with the cursor, or they are lost (BREAKING for code building SyncPage, TransactionChanges or SyncSummary)
- FIXED: a /transactions/sync page with added, modified or removed missing, null or not an array is InvalidResponse and keeps the cursor
- ADDED: Monitor: entity watchlist screening create, get, list, update, hits, reviews, history and programs; a paged list that fails at any page returns the error, never part of the list
- ADDED: Monitor.EntityScreeningOutcome.ofResults: Clear with its program and audit trail, NeedsReview or NotScreened; only cleared with every hit dismissed reads Clear
- ADDED: Webhook.EntityScreeningStatusUpdated for ENTITY_SCREENING STATUS_UPDATED (BREAKING for exhaustive matches)
v1.2.2:
- ADDED: PlaidClient.createHttpClient: an HttpClient that doesn't follow redirects. Use it or set AllowAutoRedirect = false: one that follows them sends the client id and secret to the redirect's host
v1.2.1:
- CHANGED: Webhook.KeyCache fetches a key id it never held at most once per unknownKeyInterval (default 1 s); others get KeyFetchLimited
- ADDED: KeyCache(refreshAfter, unknownKeyInterval); concurrent requests for one key id share a single fetch
- ADDED: PlaidFailure.KeyFetchLimited (BREAKING for exhaustive matches): statusCodeFor 503, action RetryLater

v1.2.0:
- ADDED: Api.getBalancesAsync (real-time balance), getItemAsync (ItemDetails), updateItemWebhookAsync
- ADDED: Api.getInstitutionAsync / searchInstitutionsAsync (name, logo, colour, OAuth)
- ADDED: Api.sandboxFireWebhookAsync / sandboxResetLoginAsync
- ADDED: FailureAction with PlaidFailure.action / PlaidApiError.action (retry, update mode, item gone, ...)
- ADDED: Webhook.WebhookUpdateAcknowledged
- ADDED: Payments: recipients, payments, standing orders, VRP consents; PayerAccount.ofAuth restricts the payer account
- ADDED: Identity: /identity/get, Identity Match (matchAsync, nameMatches), Identity Verification (create, get, retry, Link)
- ADDED: Users (user_id identity and legacy consumer_report_user_identity), Auth (numbers, processor and Stripe tokens)
- ADDED: Assets (create, get, PDF, refresh, filter, remove) and Income (bank income, payroll income, Link tokens)
- ADDED: webhook events AssetReportReady/Failed, IncomeVerification, IdentityVerificationUpdated, PaymentStatusUpdate, ConsentStatusUpdate
- ADDED: Api.postForBytesAsync; PlaidFailure.InvalidArgument for values refused before calling Plaid
- ADDED: Webhook.statusCodeFor (200 / 400 final / 503 retried); timestamp on PaymentStatusUpdate and ConsentStatusUpdate
- CHANGED: request bodies leave out ValueNone fields and empty lists; Api.postAsync bodies need no null
- CHANGED: an item or transactions webhook without item_id is InvalidResponse, was an empty ItemId
- BREAKING: new record fields Balances.LastUpdated and ItemInfo (InstitutionName, Webhook, products, UpdateType)
- BREAKING: a non-success reply without Plaid's error object is PlaidFailure.HttpError(status, body), was InvalidResponse
v1.1.0:
- ADDED: Unlicense licence
- ADDED: PlaidConfig.Sync (SyncSettings): include_original_description, personal_finance_category_version; Transaction.OriginalDescription
- ADDED: Api.createUpdateLinkTokenWithFieldsAsync for extra update-mode fields (android_package_name, ...)
- ADDED: Webhook.KeyCache with verifyCachedAsync / receiveCachedAsync
- CHANGED: Sync.fetchChangesAsync stops after SyncSettings.MaxRestarts (default 3) mutation restarts and returns the error
- BREAKING: new record fields PlaidConfig.Sync and Transaction.OriginalDescription; code building these records in full needs them
v1.0.0:
- ADDED: Link tokens (new item, update mode), public token exchange, accounts, transactions sync, refresh, item removal
- ADDED: Sync.linkItemAsync / syncItemAsync / unlinkItemAsync / refreshItemInfoAsync over IPlaidStore
- ADDED: webhook verification (Plaid-Verification ES256 JWT) and typed events, UK/EU and US/CA
- ADDED: JsonFilePlaidStore and InMemoryPlaidStore for development, CSV export
- ADDED: Api.postAsync / postRawAsync for any endpoint, Api.createLinkTokenForProductsAsync for any products
